short_description.id: Rompo adalah binatang campuran dari India dan Afrika, berkepala terwelu dan bertelinga manusia, yang menggali kuburan untuk memakan mayat.
short_description.en: The Rompo is a hybrid beast of India and Africa, with a hare's head and human ears, that digs up graves to eat corpses.

long_description.id: Rompo adalah binatang mitos yang konon ada di India dan Afrika. Ia berkepala terwelu, bertelinga manusia, bersurai, bertubuh ramping seperti kerangka, berekor berumbai, berkaki depan luak, dan berkaki belakang beruang. Ia memakan mayat manusia dari kuburan, sehingga dijuluki "Pemakan Manusia".
long_description.en: The Rompo is a mythological beast said to live in India and Africa. It has a hare's head, human ears, a mane, a slender skeletal body, a brush-like tail, a badger's forefeet and a bear's hind feet. It feeds on human corpses from graves and is therefore called the 'Man-Eater'.

long_description.id: Ia mengitari mayat beberapa kali sebelum memakannya seolah takut, dan konon bersenandung pelan saat makan. Legenda ini mungkin terilhami perilaku hyena.
long_description.en: It circles a body several times before devouring it, as if afraid, and is said to hum softly while eating. The legend may have been inspired by the behaviour of hyenas.

long_description.id: Buku Boreman tentang binatang (edisi 1794) memuat hewan ini dengan nama Rompo atau Pemakan Manusia, yang dinamai demikian karena memakan orang mati. Boreman menulis bahwa ia berdiam di hutan dan berasal dari India dan Afrika, serta mencatat bahwa orang kulit hitam berkata ia mengitari mayat beberapa kali seolah takut.
long_description.en: Boreman's book on animals (1794 edition) lists the creature as the Rompo or Man-Eater, so called because it feeds upon dead men. Boreman writes that it keeps in the woods and is bred in India and Africa, and records that the Negroes say it goes round a body several times as if afraid.

sources.title: A description of above three hundred animals, viz. Beasts, birds, ... and insects (1794 edition), entry 'Rompo'
sources.author: Thomas Boreman

claims.quote: The Rompo is a mythological beast said to have been found in India and Africa. It is described as having the head and mouth of a hare, the ears of a human, a mane, a slender body approximately three feet in length, a long tail ending in a hairy brush, the front feet of a badger, and the rear feet of a bear.

statement.id: Rompo adalah binatang mitos yang konon ada di India dan Afrika, berkepala dan bermulut terwelu, bertelinga manusia, bersurai, bertubuh ramping sekitar tiga kaki, berekor panjang dengan ujung berumbai, berkaki depan luak, dan berkaki belakang beruang.
statement.en: The Rompo is a mythological beast said to live in India and Africa, with a hare's head and mouth, human ears, a mane, a slender body about three feet long, a long tail ending in a hairy brush, a badger's forefeet and a bear's hind feet.

claims.quote: It feeds on human corpses, which it obtains by digging up graves, and is termed the "Man-Eater" due to this habit.

statement.id: Ia memakan mayat manusia yang diperolehnya dengan menggali kuburan, sehingga dijuluki "Pemakan Manusia".
statement.en: It feeds on human corpses dug from graves, and is called the 'Man-Eater' for this habit.

claims.quote: After discovering a body, instead of immediately devouring it, it circles around it several times as if afraid to seize it. The legend of the Rompo may have been inspired by the ecology and behavior of hyenas.

statement.id: Setelah menemukan mayat, ia tidak langsung memakannya tetapi mengitarinya beberapa kali seolah takut; legenda ini mungkin terilhami perilaku hyena.
statement.en: On finding a body it does not devour it at once but circles it several times as if afraid; the legend may have been inspired by hyenas' behaviour.

statement.id: Ia hanya makan mayat manusia dan konon bersenandung pelan saat makan.
statement.en: It feeds only on human corpses and is said to hum softly while eating.

statement.en: According to the Hungarian article, the Rompo has a skeletal body and a hare's head with human ears.
